Traffic Advisory

On 22.03.2026, all the heavy vehicles including Buses and Commercial vehicles will be diverted from Kalka Das Chowk and R/A Jhandewalan and these vehicles will not be allowed on DBG Road between these two points  from 1400 Hrs till 2200 Hrs.

All Buses and Commercial vehicles coming from Ajmeri Gate or R/A Idgah should take Panchkuiyan Road - R/A Bagga - Faiz Road to reach Kalka Das Chowk.

Similarly such vehicles coming from Kalka Das Chowk should take Faiz Road - R/A Bagga and then Panchkuiyan Road for onward journey.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
